text:
Maya: FYI - customer 'ArborLabs' hit multiple declines this AM. Gateway shows 'mcc_restricted' + card network decline code 57. Also ACH microdeposit lookup failed (no account match).
Jon: Do we have charge ids or invoice?
Maya: inv-9921, charges ch_02HJKL... x3. Last4 5100 (MC).
Eli: MCC restriction usually from network blocking merchant category mismatch. Which MCC did the merchant present?
Maya: Our onboarding recorded MCC 5411 (grocery) but their platform is SaaS (MCC 5815). Could be a processing mismatch on our tokenization path.
Jon: I'll pull tokenization logs and the network payload. Eli, can you open a support case with the gateway for code 57/decline reason?
Eli: Opening case now -> GATE-3247. Also suggesting we disable autopay retries for this customer pending resolution so we don't keep hitting issued cards.
Kasia: Agreed to suspend retries and offer alternate payment methods. Finance will approve wire or manual ACH if remittance included.
Maya: I DM'd the account owner. They're requesting microdeposit retry for ACH. But our bank connector returned "no_account_match" on verify.
Jon: Quick fix: re-run bank_verification with relaxed matching and capture trace_id for gateway. Command: `POST /v1/accounts/verify {"account":"****","routing":"****"}` -> capture trace_id.
Maya: Did that. trace_id t_7f9a. It still failed.
Eli: For now, let's send wire instructions and pause card retries. Zendesk ticket created: Z#10921.
ZendeskBot: Ticket Z#10921 created for ArborLabs - payment method decline.
Kasia: Wire template (internal) - Bank of the West / Redwood Inference Inc. / ACCT 987654321 / ABA 121000248 / SWIFT BWSTUS66 / Ref: ArborLabs-INV-9921
Maya: Customer asked about late fees if they switch to wire. Kasia?
Kasia: We'll waive one late fee for this month. Add note in ticket stating waiver.
Jon: I patched payments-config to stop retries for reason mcc_restricted for 30 days for this merchant_id. Deployed.
Eli: Gateway response: network flagged token due to mismatched_mcc in payload. We're updating tokenization service to send merchant_category=5815 to gateway on next token refresh. ETA 48h.
Maya: Thanks. I'll update the customer: pause retries, wire option, waiver, and we'll follow up when token refresh completes.
Kasia: Finance ops will reconcile when wire clears. Please attach remittance and bank trace.
Maya: Closing loop - added to payments retro and test harness to simulate MCC mismatch.
Jon: Logs I used: `curl -s "https://payments.redwood/internal/charges?invoice=inv-9921" | jq .`
Maya: Thanks team :thumbsup:
